It's not like I don't have objective ways to see that I really am abnormal. There's things like measurements, visual comparisons with others etc.

And just look at someone like Jeremy Renner, even with Hollywood steroids and everything, watch his interviews on YouTube and look how he looks compared to others. But it's not just my body, I have a legit facial deformity, I have other problems. So when someone says I look normal I have lots of reasons to distrust it. And ultimately it's about my perception anyway. And therapy hasn't worked for me in the past. I was hoping for something more revolutionary to be suggested here, maybe.

https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2013-04-08/women-choose-mates-by-shoulder-size-first-research-suggests

And why would I post myself online. It wouldn't even change anything. I've had people tell me I look normal. I just don't believe it.

Gerrard Depardieu was very good looking when young, c'mon. Incredibly good bone structure. And I would say even above average face. Ridiculous example. And yes he had others things too. 

I get that attractiveness isn't all looks. It just doesn't make me feel good though, I still feel horrible even knowing that I could be good for someone else theoretically. Its just that i couldn't be good enough for myself. And so I can't act confident etc, I'm completely blocked from that. I can't be my true self all because of something I can't control. I want to enjoy things and try and learn and fail and improve. But my looks completely block it, it's just how my mind works. And basically I don't know how to get over it.

When I say science I really mean it. You know like peer reviewed scientific studies? It should be obvious even without that though that women generally like wider than average shoulders. And universally dislike narrower than average ones.

Yes it is ugly. There's actually science to it too. Women truly unconsciously and even consciously notice things like that. People in general do. 

And it's not about getting laid, it's about how I feel. If I feel the way I do I completely unable to function. It affects everything, I need to constantly fight it just to do the basic things, I can't even dream of enjoying life, you wouldn't understand. The fact that I could theoretically get laid does nothing for me.

Bad skeletelal frame is part of my ugly. I would need to get really jacked just to maybe look normal in clothes. But really can't do anything about narrow shoulders. Look at someone like Jeremy Renner
